text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy grounds――

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. I just transferred in from the regional circuit
as of today, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd take a walk before the briefing starts,
but... ugh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! Why are ya makin' a girl cry?!
I'm gonna beat ya black and blue, ya hear me?!
Tamamo Cross glared threateningly, so I hurriedly made an excuse.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's how it was.
Sorry for jumpin' to conclusions.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm from the countryside myself, so I can totally
understand how lonely and anxious that kid feels.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I'll walk with ya! And while we're at it, I'll show ya the best spots around here!
choice_data_list: Show you around... like the library?
Show you around... like the gym?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right.
Can't get any studyin' done without this place!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here we are.
Got it? Keep it down in the library, alright?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing someone who just came to observe be so reliable
makes me feel like I need to step up my game too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm a student!
Can't ya see I'm wearin' a proper uniform, dammiiiit?!

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross-san, please keep your voice down in the library...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yer right.
We're gonna be usin' this place heaps from now on!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're here. This place has a full set of equipment.
Make sure ya polish up your stamina and guts properly, ya hear!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yup! As your senior, I'll do my best
to be a proper role model for you!
